name: Lyse Bouveaux
source:
Lyse is charming, clever, and an unapologetic queen of drama. She loves to gossip and play with people's hearts, and can appear callous and shallow. Though she's often irresponsible and self-destructive, she's quite sensitive and thoughtful deep down. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2584680/Black_Heaven_A_Necromantic_Dating_Sim/]Steam[/url]]
